subject: Quick follow-up: GDPR DPA & SCC option review
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Saunders <emily.saunders@fincohealth.com>, procurement@fincohealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Quick follow-up: GDPR DPA & SCC option review

Hi Emily / FinCo procurement team,

Thanks again for the call today — great to meet you all. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have the same playbook: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified (report on request). I've attached a one-page SOC 2 summary.
- HIPAA: we support HIPAA workflows; we can surface BAAs for covered workflows if needed.
- GDPR / DPA: per your question, we can provide our standard DPA (attached). We generally operate as a processor; however we can discuss controller/processor alignment where you have any joint-processing use cases.
- SCCs: for EU transfers we typically include the EU SCCs Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor) in our DPA when the customer is the controller and Redwood is the processor. If you need Module 1 or other mapping, happy to adjust — let me know which module your legal team prefers.
- Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): if you'd like, we can kick off our short VSQ to collect the specific evidence your security team needs. Link: https://redwood.ai/vsq/init?token=finco-42

Proposed next steps:
1) I can upload the DPA and SOC2 summary to your procurement portal / email them here (attached for convenience).
2) Please confirm preferred SCC module (Module 2 = Controller -> Processor is our default) and whether FinCo will act as Controller for the product scope discussed.
3) If you want the VSQ started, confirm a point of contact and I'll submit the invite.

If useful I can loop in our privacy lead (Laura) and sales lead (Ben) to help with legal/procurement friction.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_template_v2.docx (DPA template), Redwood_SOC2-Summary_2025.pdf (SOC 2 summary)

From: Emily Saunders <emily.saunders@fincohealth.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 18:01:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: GDPR DPA & SCC option review

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear recap and the docs. A few quick notes from legal/procurement: 

- Confirmed FinCo will act as Controller for the product data scope discussed; Redwood will be Processor.
- Procurement prefers the EU SCCs Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor) added to the DPA; please include the latest Module 2 text.
- We will need: the DPA, SOC 2 report (or summary), and an initial completion of your VSQ so our security team can triage any open items.

Point of contact for the VSQ: me (Emily) and procurement@fincohealth.com. Can you kick that off and loop in whoever will provide the evidence for encryption and logging?

We aim to get to contracting by end of month pending redlines.

Best,
Emily Saunders
Head of Information Security (acting) | FinCo Health
emily.saunders@fincohealth.com

Marcus / Laura — quick internal alignment before we send the tracked DPA: 

- Stick to Module 2 language (Controller -> Processor) as requested; avoid unnecessary controller-side obligations that increase operational cost.
- SOC 2: provide the summary now; full report available under NDA if they request.
- Logging/retention: propose standard 90-day request window for audit logs (we can extend for enterprise at cost).
- Encryption: we will confirm at-rest AES-256 and TLS1.3 in transit in the VSQ evidence.
- Risk: if legal pushes for joint-controller language, escalate to me — that can materially change duties and we should route to Legal.

I'll review the tracked DPA before we send.
